_help: Settings for the SOFiSTiK MCP server. Edit in Notepad, save, then fully quit and restart Claude. Use double backslashes in paths.
_sofistik_dir: Leave empty to find SOFiSTiK 2027/2026/2025 automatically, or give the folder that holds sps.exe, e.g. C:\Program Files\SOFiSTiK\2027\SOFiSTiK 2027
_work_folders: Claude may write .dat files and run calculations only inside these folders. Add your project folders here, e.g. "D:\26016 HPC Kier BAM JV".
_read_folders: Extra folders Claude may read (results, .dat, .prt) but never change.
_allow_sys_commands: false = refuse to run any .dat containing +SYS (which runs Windows commands). Only set true if you need it.
_dashboard_port: Live dashboard page: http://localhost:8765 on this PC. 0 switches it off.
_dashboard_lan: true lets a phone or laptop on the same Wi-Fi open http://<this PC's name>:8765 (Windows asks once to allow it). Anyone on that network can then see the page (read only).
